newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya president clears BBC to broadcast on FM.
newsitem.headline: Kenya president clears BBC to broadcast on FM.

text.p: President Daniel Arap Moi has cleared the way for the British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC) to rebroadcast its World Service radio on Kenyan FM frequencies.
Moi's gave his support to the BBC application in a speech in Nairobi on Monday at celebrations marking the 40th anniversary of the BBC World Service Swahili and Somali language services.
The BBC had applied to rebroadcast World Service radio on FM frequencies on a 24-hour basis from the capital Nairobi and the Indian Ocean port city of Mombasa, Kenya's two main centres.
Seven African countries already re-broadcast selected World Service programmes on FM. In March, Uganda began rebroadcasting the BBC World Service through Capital Radio based in Kampala.
